stem: Which of the following groups are mandatory reporters in the community based on their interaction with children?

options.text: School principals, police, and childcare workers
All members of the general public and neighbours
Only health professionals working in public hospitals
Retail workers and hospitality staff in family venues

explanation: Mandatory reporters include school principals, police, and childcare workers.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because school principals, police, and childcare workers are identified as mandatory reporters because of their roles and contact with children.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because the general public may report concerns, but they are not designated mandatory reporters simply by being community members.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because mandatory reporting is not limited to health professionals working in public hospitals.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because retail and hospitality staff in family venues are not part of the specified mandatory reporter groups.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because sports coaches and after-school tutors are not the groups identified as mandatory reporters in this context.

source.hint: Consider the specific roles mentioned that are part of the education, justice, or welfare systems.
